Summary Description: Dr. Shane Connelly is a cross-disciplinary scholar whose work integrates health communication, misinformation, and public health behavior in crisis contexts with organizational behavior, leadership, and group dynamics in technology-enabled environments. He employs rigorous mixed-methods designs and advanced econometric techniques to address endogeneity and causal mechanisms, while advocating replication and open-science practices to advance robust knowledge in psychology, public health, and leadership studies. His research offers actionable insights for vaccine messaging and counter-misinformation efforts, as well as understanding how technology and leadership processes influence organizational resilience during pandemics and crises.
